title: State of Madras v. Champakam Dorairajan

content.caseIdentity: State of Madras v. Champakam Dorairajan, 1951 SCR 525
content.holding: Communal reservation in medical/engineering colleges struck down for violating Article 29(2); prompted the Constitution (First Amendment) Act 1951 inserting Article 15(4).
content.relevance: Genesis of Article 15(4) and early formal equality approach.

evidence.note: 7-Judge Constitution Bench judgment in Case No. 271 of 1951; 1951 INSC 25; 1951 SCR 525; AIR 1951 SC 226.
